name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v537: Cloudflare bypass hardening. (1) Always require cf_clearance before marking a solve successful - the expanded dialog no longer skips the clearance check. (2) Removed the dead JavaScript document.cookie probe that could never see HttpOnly cf_clearance. (3) The bypass dialog now fails its in-flight deferred when the view is destroyed mid-solve, so the next probe can show the dialog again. (4) Remote API config load no longer blocks plugin load - it runs in the background instead of runBlocking, preventing TV startup freezes. (5) Tightened WebView security on both solver WebViews: MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW, allowFileAccess=false, allowContentAccess=false, no multiple windows or automatic popups. (6) Removed redundant double-poll in headless mode. All v536 fixes retained.
